messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Needed help on loading packages
parts:
Hi Shyamkiran,

Renjin's interactive REPL downloads packages on demand, so library(yourpackagename) should be sufficient. 

However, not all packages are (yet) compatible with Renjin, visit http://packages.renjin.org to find the status of the package you need.

For RODBC specifically,  you might want to look at the blog post on Renjin's DBI packages, which provide database access based on JDBC.

Best,
Alex
